subject.title: Bug: License incorrectly displayed as MIT-0 instead of MIT

question: Should ClawHub support declared standard MIT licenses alongside its existing platform-wide MIT-0 policy, including repairing already-published versions with authoritative MIT metadata?
rationale: The reported output is legally inaccurate for this package, but correcting it reverses an explicit shipped product guarantee that all published skills use MIT-0.

options.title: Support declared MIT
options.body: Accept standard MIT from authoritative root metadata and repair existing versions that were defaulted to MIT-0 despite clear MIT declarations.

options.title: Retain MIT-0 only
options.body: Keep the platform-wide license but reject publication or show a prominent conflict warning when package metadata declares incompatible terms.

recommendation.title: Support declared MIT
recommendation.body: Accept standard MIT from authoritative root metadata and repair existing versions that were defaulted to MIT-0 despite clear MIT declarations.

likelyOwner.reason: This person established both the original implementation and the explicit fixed-license product direction being reconsidered.
